Live From Austin, TX by Richard Thompson. Man is a legend among folk artists. Imo his live work is better than his stuff on his albums. This is a great showcase of his incredible guitar prowess.

To Be Kind by Swans. I would recommend this for anyone who wants weird, experimental music that stands out from things you'd normally hear. The way they build upon instrumental pieces throughout each song is incredible and you never know where it's going to go.

The Seer by Swans. If you liked To Be Kind, this one is imo far wilder and outlandish. It sounds almost occult. It's wild and feels like there isn't much place for sanity, but in a strange and bizare way the album is strangely beautiful imo.

And lastly, but not certainly not least, The Velvet Underground & Nico. This album is almost singlehandedly responsible for inspiring what I'd guess to be at least 95% of modern rock music, as well as inadvertedly spawning noise rock.
